mapper.select: SELECT t1.id, t1.dict_type_id, t1.enum_name, t1.enum_code, t1.sort, t1.remark, t1.is_lock, t2.type_code AS dictTypeCode FROM mk_sys_dict AS t1 LEFT JOIN mk_sys_dict_type AS t2 ON t2.id = t1.dict_type_id WHERE t1.dict_type_id = #{dictTypeId} AND t1.is_delete = 0 AND t2.is_delete = 0
